sources.title: Microglia sculpt postnatal neural circuits in an activity and complement-dependent manner
sources.authors: Schafer DP, Lehrman EK, Kautzman AG, Koyama R, Mardinly AR, Yamasaki R, Ransohoff RM, Greenberg ME, Barres BA, Stevens B
sources.access_method: PMC open access - full text read
sources.key_findings: C3b-CR3 mechanism; 35% microglia contain synaptic material at P5; CR3 KO 1.3x increase in synapses; TTX→preference for inactive eye pruning; Forskolin protects synapses
sources.limitations: Mainly mouse retinogeniculate circuit; unknown if selection rules generalize across regions

sources.title: Lynx1, a cholinergic brake, limits plasticity in adult visual cortex
sources.authors: Morishita H, Miwa JM, Heintz N, Hensch TK
sources.access_method: PMC open access - full text read
sources.key_findings: Lynx1 KO adult CBI=0.55 vs WT 0.68 (p<0.0001); amblyopia recovery 0.56 vs 0.30 cyc/deg; physostigmine partial rescue 0.48; nAChR antagonists block KO effect
sources.limitations: Mouse model; clinical translation of cholinergic strategy for human amblyopia not tested

sources.title: Perineuronal Nets in the Developing Brain: Implications for Neurodevelopmental Disorders
sources.authors: Ackerman JM, Ford TJL, Kattewar SS, Kim WY
sources.access_method: PMC open access - full text read
sources.key_findings: PNN composition (HA+lecticans+Tenascin-R); mouse V1 PNN matures P30-45; 6-S→4-S sulfation shift with age; PNN density increases to age 84 in humans; ChABC effects on plasticity and memory
sources.limitations: Limited human data; PNN as cause vs consequence of critical period closure not fully resolved

sources.title: The classical complement cascade mediates CNS synapse elimination
sources.authors: Stevens B, Allen NJ, Vazquez LE, Howell GR, Christopherson KS, Nouri N, Micheva KD, Mehalow AK, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Smith SJ, John SW, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Barres BA
sources.access_method: abstract only - no PMC open access version found
sources.key_findings: C1q expressed by postnatal neurons in response to immature astrocytes; localizes to synapses; C1q null mice show failed synapse elimination
sources.limitations: Abstract only - full data not reviewed

sources.title: Synaptic pruning by microglia is necessary for normal brain development
sources.authors: Paolicelli RC, Bolasco G, Pagani F, Maggi L, Scianni M, Panzanelli P, Giustetto M, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL
sources.key_findings: CX3CR1 KO mice: impaired synaptic pruning, excess synapses, immature hippocampal circuits, autism-spectrum behavioral deficits
sources.limitations: Abstract only - full data not reviewed

sources.title: Critical period plasticity in local cortical circuits
sources.key_findings: E/I balance (PV+ cells) triggers critical period onset; GAD65 KO fails to open; diazepam opens prematurely; proteolytic ECM reorganization in closure
sources.limitations: Abstract only - comprehensive review, key findings well-established by multiple labs

sources.title: Reactivation of ocular dominance plasticity in the adult visual cortex
sources.authors: Pizzorusso T, Medini P, Berardi N, Chierzi S, Fawcett JW, Maffei L
sources.key_findings: ChABC injection in adult rat V1 degrades PNN → monocular deprivation again induces OD shift; mature ECM inhibits experience-dependent plasticity
sources.limitations: Abstract only; rat model; long-term safety and selectivity of ChABC not covered

sources.title: Balancing plasticity/stability across brain development
sources.key_findings: Established 'molecular brakes' framework: plasticity is actively dampened, not passively lost; two core concepts: E/I trigger (opening) + molecular brakes (closure)

sources.title: Critical-period plasticity in the visual cortex
sources.key_findings: Comprehensive review of critical period cellular and molecular mechanisms in visual cortex

sources.title: Complement and microglia mediate early synapse loss in Alzheimer mouse models
sources.authors: Hong S, Beja-Glasser VF, Nfonoyim BM, Frouin A, Li S, Ramakrishnan S, Merry KM, Shi Q, Rosenthal A, Barres BA, Lemere CA, Selkoe DJ, Stevens B
sources.access_method: abstract only (PMC linked but access status not confirmed)
sources.key_findings: C1q elevated at AD synapses before plaque formation; C1q KO reduces synaptic loss in AD models; links developmental pruning mechanism to AD pathology
